incident-bot: ALERT: Canary group 'wave-7' healthcheck failure rate 4.8% over 2m, 5xx spike detected. Abort criteria met — automatic safety cut not yet applied. Paging @sara-oncall :rotating_light:

sara-oncall: taking this — looking at metrics and logs now.

raj-eng: I'm on the deploy. Which toggle controls canary routing for wave-7?

julia-se: any customer-facing errors reported?

sara-oncall: US-EAST is seeing the majority. 502/503s up, latency p95 up ~2x. Affected requests are streaming-gen and tool-calls. No active support tickets yet but sampling shows user transactions failing.

matt-sre: likely KV cache mismatch with the quantized model variant — seeing rapid cache miss / stall in traces. Suggest we cut canary to 0% and roll back the routing change.

raj-eng: doing quick rollback. Running: ```
/deploy rollback --target=wave-7 --reason="health-spike" --wait
```

deploy-bot: rollback job accepted (job_id=98765). ETA ~30s for policy flip.

sara-oncall: toggling feature flag to stop canary traffic: ```
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/api/flags/wave-7/override -d '{"enabled":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx'
```

deploy-bot: feature-flag override applied by sara-oncall (tx_id=fb3c). Beginning routing drain.

incident-bot: NOTE: Abort criteria hit. Rollout paused. If errors continue after rollback completes, escalate to SE-ENG.

raj-eng: rollback complete from deploy side (job_id=98765) — traffic shifted back to stable model version. Verification checks running.

sara-oncall: quick health check: p50/p95 latency trending down, 5xx rate dropped to baseline in us-east. Sample logs: ```
[service] 2026-03-17T12:34:56Z ERR upstream 502 "kvcache miss and timeout"
[service] 2026-03-17T12:35:02Z INFO routing switched to stable-model-v2
```

julia-se: thanks. Any indication of customers impacted during the ~4m window?

sara-oncall: estimate ~0.6% of total requests, mostly short-lived errors. Recommend outreach only if we see support tickets.

matt-sre: capturing KV cache dump and related traces to a temp S3 for the postmortem: s3://redwood-incidents/wave-7/4891234567. Do not delete.

raj-eng: I'll own the postmortem and the follow-up rollout plan (testing harness for quantized variant + KV cache warming).

sara-oncall: handing off on-call to raj-eng for the follow-up and postmortem. Pager cleared for now. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Canary wave-7 aborted and rolled back at 4891234567. Root cause suspected: kvcache invalidation + incompatible quantized kernel. Next steps: postmortem by raj-eng, alerts to be tuned for prefix-caching pattern.

raj-eng: noted — will schedule postmortem and include repro script and workload replay. Adding julia-se and matt-sre as reviewers.

sara-oncall: thanks team, closing the on-call thread.
